title: MRI checklist: how to prepare for your scan

slides.title: Before you leave home
items: Wear comfy clothes with no metal zippers, buttons or underwire.
Leave jewelry, watches and hair clips at home.
Using insurance? Bring your card and your doctor's order.

slides.title: Please tell us about:
items: A pacemaker, implant or surgical hardware.
Any metal in your body, even from an old injury.
A medication patch. Some contain metal.
A pregnancy, or a chance of one.
slides.footnote: Our technologist reviews a safety checklist with you before every scan. Sources: FDA; RadiologyInfo.org (ACR and RSNA).

slides.title: How your visit goes.
steps: A short safety questionnaire with our technologist.
30 to 60 minutes for most exams. Tapping and humming sounds are normal.
Drive, eat and get back to your day. Results go to your doctor within 72 hours.

slides.title: You have options.
cards: MRI with more room than traditional machines
can stay in the Open MRI room with you
slides.footnote: Very anxious? Ask your doctor if a mild sedative could help.
